name: amazon-cloudfront-access-logs-queries
description: This is a sample implementation for the concepts described in the AWS blog post "Analyzing your Amazon CloudFront access logs at scale".

scripts.destroy:integration: aws s3 rm s3://$(aws cloudformation describe-stack-resources --stack-name cf-logs-integration-test --query 'StackResources[?LogicalResourceId==`CloudFrontAccessLogsBucket`].PhysicalResourceId' --output text) --recursive && aws cloudformation delete-stack --stack-name cf-logs-integration-test
